description: enforce_for_delivery returns Ok(()) on DNS errors and HTTPS fetch errors, only logging warnings. This is the correct RFC 8461 §2 behaviour: 'policy fetch failures MUST NOT prevent message delivery'. A contributor might suggest returning Err to be safe — that would be wrong and cause delivery failures for all domains with transient DNS problems.
title: fail-open on DNS/HTTPS errors correctly implements RFC 8461 §2
